title_en: Jiepao Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. v. Qingdao Hisense Import & Export Co., Ltd. — dispute over an international sales contract
ruling_gist_en: 1. The 'quality requirements' in the warranty liability for defects of the subject matter in an international contract for the sale of goods typically include the technical standards and quality requirements stipulated by the exporting and importing countries. In the absence of explicit and specific agreements between the buyer and seller on quality standards and requirements, the comparability of items and technical specifications between the pre-delivery and post-delivery inspections renders changes in inspection results before and after delivery more capable of specifically reflecting the product's quality condition.
